promise.text: Each swipe gets a clear job, and the reader leaves with a checklist.

meta.hypothesis: A plain command cover earns more saves than a question cover.

cover_options: Why readers stop at slide two
Your carousel has too many ideas
caption:
Most carousels lose people on one crowded slide.

Give each slide a single job, make the next swipe worth it, and end on something the reader can use. Save this for your next brief.

#CarouselDesign #ContentDesign #BrandIdentity

slides.headline: Make every swipe count.
slides.alt: Green cover with the headline Make every swipe count above three overlapping cards.

slides.headline: One slide. One useful idea.
slides.body: A crowded slide asks readers to do the editing. Give each idea room.
slides.alt: Ivory slide explaining that a crowded slide makes the reader do the editing.
slides.visual_prompt: Open ivory field, left-aligned headline, generous negative space.

slides.headline: Say what changes.
items: Post more often | Post one clear idea

slides.headline: Build a clear sequence.
slides.alt: Timeline of four points: name the problem, explain why, show one action, hand over something to keep.
slides.visual_prompt: Vertical thread with four nodes on charcoal.

slides.headline: Check the essentials.
slides.alt: Three-item checklist: readable at phone size, same identity on every slide, a takeaway worth saving.

slides.headline: Start with your reader.
slides.body: Choose one problem. Leave people with something they can use.
